#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

int maxOutsideWord(const string& text) {
    int max_len = 0;
    istringstream iss(text);
    string word;
    while (getline(iss, word, '_')) {
        max_len = max(max_len, (int)word.length());
    }
    return max_len;
}

int countInsideWords(const string& text) {
    int count = 0;
    istringstream iss(text);
    string word;
    while (getline(iss, word, '_')) {
        if (!word.empty()) {
            count++;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n >> s;
    bool openParenthesis = false;
    string sb;
    vector<int> outsideMaxes;
    vector<int> insideCounts;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        char c = s[i];
        if (c == '(') {
            if (!openParenthesis) {
                outsideMaxes.push_back(maxOutsideWord(sb));
            }
            openParenthesis = true;
            sb.clear();
        } else if (c == ')') {
            openParenthesis = false;
            insideCounts.push_back(countInsideWords(sb));
            sb.clear();
        } else {
            sb.push_back(c);
        }
    }
    outsideMaxes.push_back(maxOutsideWord(sb));

    int maxOutside = 0;
    for (int m : outsideMaxes) {
        maxOutside = max(maxOutside, m);
    }

    int nbrInside = 0;
    for (int c : insideCounts) {
        nbrInside += c;
    }

    cout << maxOutside << " " << nbrInside << endl;
    return 0;
}
